culled.en: Your summer clothes can stop volunteering.
School bags packed. Hands still defrosting.
The school run starts with negotiating the car doors.
School starts soon. Your fingers haven't.
The school run now involves finding the school.
Your school shoes will need their own bath.
Uniform on. Spare uniform suddenly makes sense.
The school run slows down. The bell doesn't.
The school still wants them there, unfortunately.
Dinner is looking like the highlight of your holiday.
Your holiday photos could have been taken at home.

rows.en: That lawn stopped asking the sky for rain somewhere around the start of November.
rows.af: Daardie grasperk het êrens teen die begin van November opgehou om die lug vir reën te vra.

rows.en: Nobody in this dorp has needed a stove since about the second week of December.
rows.af: Niemand in hierdie dorp het sedert omtrent die tweede week van Desember 'n stoof nodig gehad nie.

rows.en: Clouds are crying like NZ at the 23 Rugby WC!
rows.af: Die wolke huil soos die All Blacks ná die 2023-Wêreldbeker!

preset.by: Al, in the 2026-09-19 brief: a past event, it plays on any hard-rain day

rows.en: Summer filed its arrival notice this morning; the shirt is the paperwork.
rows.af: Die somer het vanoggend sy aankomskennisgewing ingedien; die hemp is die papierwerk.

rows.en: Agapanthus out, hadeda busy, sky empty: high summer is running on schedule.
rows.af: Agapante oop, hadeda besig, lug leeg: hoogsomer loop volgens skedule.

rows.en: Cancel everything. This is THE day winter was hiding.
rows.af: Kanselleer alles. Dis DIÉ dag.

rows.en: Half this street is in summer and the other half is about to be somewhere else.
rows.af: Die helfte van hierdie straat is in die somer, en die ander helfte gaan nou-nou êrens anders wees.

rows.en: Some clouds. Some sun. South African summer admin.
rows.af: Sonnig met n spatsel wolke. SA somer in een prentjie.

rows.en: Pink-grey sky over the robots: winter is on the morning shift too.
rows.af: Pienkgrys lug oor die robotte: die winter werk ook die oggendskof.

rows.en: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by supper.
rows.af: Joburg somerreën: kom vyfuur, deurweek alles, weg teen aandete.

rows.en: Jacaranda season and a Monday, and the paving is taking both badly.
rows.af: Jakarandaseisoen en 'n Maandag, en die plaveisel vat albei sleg.

rows.en: The jacaranda is dropping purple on a lawn he has just finished watering.
rows.af: Die jakaranda laat pers val op 'n grasperk wat hy pas natgemaak het.

rows.en: Every jacaranda on this street is emptying itself onto one man.
rows.af: Elke jakaranda in hierdie straat maak homself op een man leeg.

rows.en: The jacaranda is redecorating the whole road whether you like it or not.
rows.af: Die jakaranda herversier die hele pad of jy daarvan hou of nie.

rows.en: Jacaranda blossom and stormwater, which is Joburg's least favourite combination.
rows.af: Jakarandablomme en stormwater — die kombinasie waarvan Joburg die minste hou.

rows.en: Friday evening, snow on the Apostles, and the only queue is for the kettle.
rows.af: Vrydagaand, sneeu op die Apostels, en die enigste tou is vir die ketel.

rows.en: Snow on the mountain. The kind of cold Cape Town frames and hangs on the wall.
rows.af: Sneeu op die berg. Die soort koue wat Kaapstad raam en teen die muur hang.

rows.en: Snow on the berg, washing on the line: cold enough to freeze, dry enough to try.
rows.af: Sneeu op die berg, wasgoed op die draad: koud genoeg om te vries, droog genoeg om te probeer.

rows.en: Clear skies, open roads, running nose. The full winter set.
rows.af: Die lug is oop, die pad is oop, jou neus loop.

rows.en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
rows.af: Hoëveld-winter: die enigste plek waar jy twee jasse aantrek om die pos te gaan haal.

rows.en: The Free State just remembered it has a winter setting.
rows.af: Die Vrystaat het pas onthou hy het 'n winter-setting.

rows.en: Clear nights are winter's way of apologising.
rows.af: Helder nagte is die winter se jammer-sê.

rows.en: Winter sun: all of the light, none of the heat. Nice try, sun.
rows.af: Winterson: al die lig, nul van die hitte. Mooi probeer, son.

rows.en: Not one cloud, not one degree: a Highveld winter morning doing both at once.
rows.af: Nie een wolk nie, nie een graad nie: 'n Hoëveldse wintermôre doen albei gelyk.

rows.en: Frost right up to the dam wall: the Karoo did its winter thing overnight.
rows.af: Ryp tot teen die damwal: die Karoo het oornag sy winterding gedoen.

rows.en: Joburg winter dawn: the view is free; the air charges admission.
rows.af: Joburg winterdagbreek: die uitsig is verniet; die lug vra toegangsgeld.

rows.en: Coats and coffees in full sun: winter in this city photographs like summer.
rows.af: Jasse en koffies in vol son: winter in hierdie stad lyk op foto's soos somer.

rows.en: Frost on the grass, steam off the field: winter running weather at its most honest.
rows.af: Ryp op die gras, stoom van die veld af: wintersdrafweer op sy eerlikste.

rows.en: That washing is not dry; it is preserved. Winter dusk works fast out here.
rows.af: Daardie wasgoed is nie droog nie; dit is ingelê. Winterskemer werk vinnig hier.

rows.en: Braaiing in beanies under a hard clear sky: winter never cancelled anything here.
rows.af: Braai met musse op onder 'n kristalhelder lug: die winter kanselleer niks hier nie.

rows.en: Small dog, thick jersey, short patrol: winter mornings run on reduced hours.
rows.af: Klein hond, dik trui, kort patrollie: winteroggende werk verkorte ure.

rows.en: Construction finished at nine: one duvet cave, single occupant, no visitors till spring.
rows.af: Bouwerk klaar om nege: een duvetgrot, een bewoner, geen besoekers tot die lente nie.

rows.en: It is heater season, and the best seat in the house has fur on it.
rows.af: Dis verwarmerseisoen, en die beste sitplek in die huis het pels op.

rows.en: The mountain is in there somewhere, wrapped up for the winter.
rows.af: Die berg is daar êrens, toegedraai vir die winter.

rows.en: Every streetlamp down the road is lighting nobody; winter nights empty a dorp early.
rows.af: Elke straatlig langs die pad skyn vir niemand nie; winternagte maak 'n dorp vroeg leeg.

rows.en: Fingerless gloves at a laptop: winter has entered the home office.
rows.af: Vingerlose handskoene by 'n laptop: winter het die tuiskantoor betree.

rows.en: Frost on the lawn and wors on the grid: a Cape winter compromise.
rows.af: Ryp op die grasperk en wors op die rooster: 'n Kaapse winterkompromie.

rows.en: Beanie, snood, torch, book: winter nights build the best reading rooms.
rows.af: Mus, nekwarmer, flits, boek: winternagte bou die beste leeskamers.

rows.en: Wet road, grey sky, dog in a jersey: winter is fully operational.
rows.af: Nat pad, grys lug, hond in 'n trui: winter is ten volle in werking.

rows.en: Socks go on the heater first; feet join later — the winter system works.
rows.af: Sokkies gaan eerste op die verwarmer; voete kom later — die winterstelsel werk.

rows.en: Chair turned to the heater, blanket up, tea close: winter Sunday, executed correctly.
rows.af: Stoel na die verwarmer gedraai, kombers op, tee naby: wintersondag, korrek uitgevoer.

rows.en: That sprinkler has been the best-value thing in this garden all summer.
rows.af: Daardie sproeier is die hele somer die beste waarde in hierdie tuin.

rows.en: This light lasts about twenty minutes and the walk to school gets all of it.
rows.af: Hierdie lig hou omtrent twintig minute, en die stap skool toe kry alles.

rows.en: Two beanies, one scraper, minus three: the school run starts before the car agrees.
rows.af: Twee musse, een skraper, minus drie: die skoolrit begin voor die kar instem.

rows.en: Breath like smoke, frost on the glass, sun already out: Highveld school run.
rows.af: Asem soos rook, ryp op die glas, son reeds op: Hoëveldse skoolrit.

rows.en: Beanie plus puffer plus school tie: the cold front has reached the uniform.
rows.af: Mus plus poffer plus skooldas: die kouefront het die skooldrag bereik.

rows.en: The sun has done more to that lawn this month than any mower ever will.
rows.af: Die son het hierdie maand meer aan daardie grasperk gedoen as wat enige grassnyer ooit sal.

rows.en: Every leaf the tree dropped this month is going past them at head height.
rows.af: Elke blaar wat die boom hierdie maand laat val het, gaan op kophoogte by hulle verby.

rows.en: Bottle this one. Open it in winter.
rows.af: Bottel hierdie een. Maak hom oop in die winter.

rows.en: The sea keeps its winter colour under a sky like this, whatever the calendar says.
rows.af: Die see hou sy winterkleur onder so 'n lug, wat die kalender ook al sê.

rows.en: The agapanthus open for exactly this kind of sky, and they got it.
rows.af: Die agapante gaan oop vir presies hierdie soort lug, en hulle het dit gekry.

rows.en: Cricket till the light goes, and light like this takes its time going.
rows.af: Krieket tot die lig weg is, en lig soos dié vat sy tyd om te gaan.

rows.en: Flat grey over the rugby field: perfect kicking weather, no wind to blame.
rows.af: Plat grys oor die rugbyveld: perfekte skopweer, geen wind om te blameer nie.

rows.en: Lekker koud, but the rugby fields are about to look perfect.
rows.af: Lekker koud, maar die rugbyvelde gaan nou-nou perfek lyk.

rows.en: Perfect rugby weather. For the spectators with blankets.
rows.af: Perfekte rugbyweer. Vir die toeskouers met komberse.

rows.en: Blue sky, gold grass, white edges: a Highveld rugby morning in full kit.
rows.af: Blou lug, goue gras, wit rande: 'n Hoëveldse rugbyoggend in volle drag.

rows.names: load shedding (approved in the Eskom ruling, 2026-09-22)
rows.en: Nature's doing its own load shedding.
rows.af: Natuur doen sy eie beurtkrag.

rows.en: This is the weather you'll miss in December traffic.
rows.af: Dit is die weer wat jy sal mis in Desember-verkeer.

rows.en: Cancel everything. This is THE day winter was hiding.
rows.af: Kanselleer alles. Dis DIÉ dag.

rows.en: Highveld winter flex: laundry dry before the kettle's even done.
rows.af: Hoëveld-winter: die wasgoed is droog voor die ketel kook.

rows.en: Off-season beach: same ocean, zero fight for parking.
rows.af: Strand in die winter: dieselfde see, nul geveg oor parkering.

rows.en: Every glow down there is someone else who also can't believe it's already winter.
rows.af: Elke liggie daar onder is iemand wat ook nie kan glo dis al winter nie.
